name: hai_dang_vung_tau_edits
sources: The lighthouse of Vũng Tàu (Hải đăng Vũng Tàu) on Núi Nhỏ, from edits: the look of its photos. The catalog has it also as a tower that the people build, with its stair inside (hai_dang_vung_tau). Its article (vi.wikipedia.org): a round white tower 18 m high and 3 m across, built in 1862 and built again in 1913 at 170 m over the sea.

The sizes are those of the tower of the catalog (measured on a photo with the platform of OpenStreetMap as the scale, ±10%): a round body of 3.2 m, 5.1 m across its four ribs, a platform of 7.8 m. From about ten photos (two of Wikimedia Commons; travel pages for study only): the foot of 6.6 m, the lantern of 2.85 m, the gallery of 5.8 m.

From the photos: two deep rings between the ribs, the gallery on a round corbel with a rail of dark iron, the lantern (a wall of 2 m, two rows of panes, a dome with a ladder and a ball), a plinth with a slope at each face, a plate of brass. A guess: the heights of the rings and of the gallery (the photos look up), the door at the back. The house of the keeper is not made.
